about: Published floor for NIDO Esencial: measured from the files built by the CI for release knowledge-packs-v12 (draft release 433018692, built 2026-11-03 from main 6a8b8df by knowledge-pack run 41685204901; nido-esencial.sqlite sha256 f1324cf5…, nido-esencial-e5.sqlite sha256 5c0f7ebe…, counts read from their guides and chunks tables). Advanced 2026-11-03 on the candidate branch of the app version that will publish v12, by the owner's encargo after the 0.1.70 audit (charges C-2 and C-3): v12 carries the same re-verified clinical text as v11, with the family-question keys on every guide, and its counts equal v11's. This record takes effect when the release is published with that app version. A future Esencial candidate below these counts would silently take guides away from everyone who updates.

previousPublished.note: The v11 floor this record held until v12 shipped.
